title: Biostratigraphy of the deep corehole (Clubhouse Crossroads corehole 1) near Charleston, South Carolina
citation: Hazel, J.E., Bybell, L.M., Christopher, R.A., Frederiksen, N.O., May, F.E., McLean, D.M., Poore, R.Z., Smith, C.C., Sohl, N.F., Valentine, P.C., and Witmer, R.J., 1977, Biostratigraphy of the deep corehole (Clubhouse Crossroads corehole 1) near Charleston, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Professional Paper 1028-F [p. 71-89], map scale 1:2,653,573.
notes: Chapter F of Professional Paper 1028 only (PDF pages 99-121). Unit thicknesses are from the summary table in the abstract (page 103). The Pleistocene(?) interval is 6 m in that table but 5 m (16 ft) in the text on page 105; both are recorded. Formation depth ranges in the core are from the text; the cumulative stage boundaries and microfossil zone depths in the Fauna and Flora section, the correlation charts (figs. 3-4) and sedimentation-rate tables 1-2 were not recorded value by value. Rank 'Formation' is inferred from unit names. Reference names are written without the OCR-like errors of the page (e.g. 'Soh!' as 'Sohl'); the quotes keep them. The 'Pessagno 1969' and 'Young 1965' entries are dash-continuation entries; author names were carried from the entry above (inferred).
